crossRefs.note: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness…
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

parallels.note: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
